title: RenaissanceRe Holdings Ltd. (NYSE: RNR) — Refreshed Underwriting Monograph & Valuation Rejection
primer: RenaissanceRe (NYSE: RNR, CMP $343.97) is an elite Bermuda catastrophe reinsurer backed by REMS modeling and Capital Partners fees [1, 4, 21]. At 1.42x Q3 2026 TBVPS ($242.51), shares already price a 13.0% mid-cycle ROAE at a 10.50% cost of equity [18, 23, 28]. Forensic filing audits uncovered softening cat rates (-19.9% GPW), a 110.6% Q3 Casualty combined ratio, and four-quarter fee attrition [3, 18]. They also flagged 4.2-year bond duration risk and December 31, 2026 CFO and CPO retirements [3, 13]. With +1.5% 12-month expected return ($349.00 EV) and 0.79:1 Base R:R, we assign REJECTED (Tier 0), hold 0 shares, and allocate 100% of marginal cash to USD Cash [29, 31, 33].
holding_rationale: RNR is NOT_HELD (0 common shares, 0 options) across all Schwab and Robinhood accounts on the 2026-11-20 positions ledger. Total US cash is $2,540.35 (3.38% of $75,110.60 net worth) against a 22.0% Downtrend floor, and RNR options show NO_OPTIONS_EDGE. Because +1.5% expected return ($349.00 EV) and 0.79:1 Base R:R fail our 1.50:1 hurdle on VALUATION and BUSINESS grounds, deploy $0 into RNR and monitor passively.
